findings.title: existsSync checked twice per skill in skillsReport
findings.detail:
skillsReport computes missing with existsSync, and then skillsDrift runs existsSync again for every name. This is harmless and only costs a few stat calls.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave as is; not worth a rework round.
